description: This file contains the server-side logic for the UserProfile page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles loading user data from a SQL Server database, session validation, and navigation to other pages like dashboard, leaderboard, and login.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile page, managing user session, data retrieval, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves user data from database based on session ID, and populates UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended for profile button click; currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logging out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the taken courses page.
